elements.name: List 3D Model panels from the side-docked tab menu

steps.name: the 3D Model ribbon is active and docked at the left side
the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab
the user opens Show Panels from the ribbon context menu

the submenu lists Sketch, Primitives, Create, Modify, Explore, Work Features, Pattern, Create Freeform, Surface, Parameters, Simplification, Plastic Part, Measure, Insert, Harness, iPart/Assembly, Simulation, Convert and 3D Print
